mutations.because: Dropping packaging's expiry re-check against packagedAt lets an expired licence's asset package as if it were still cleared, so the expired-licence refusal test must fail.
command: refuses the whole request when an asset's licence expired before packagedAt, naming the asset and licence; nothing is written

mutations.because: Dropping the legal gate's territory halt lets a run whose targetRegion is outside the licence's territories proceed, so the uncovered-territory halt test must fail.
command: halts when targetRegion is not covered by territories

mutations.because: Dropping the audio write-back from toBrief makes the editor silently strip a loaded brief's licence record on save, so the audio round-trip test must fail.
command: a loaded brief with audio round-trips and opens clean

mutations.because: Making the Z/offset optional again on a date-time lets an offset-less expiresOn (read as the host's local time) parse, so the no-Z/offset refusal test must fail (VE3a fix2 #1).
command: refuses a date-time with no Z/offset

command: has an unknown key refused, naming the key

command: isPersistedAsset refuses audioRights on a non-motion row

mutations.because: Reverting to the shape-only audio retention (path a string, rights an object) lets a record with empty rights survive recovery, so the empty-rights recovery test must fail (VE3a fix3 mutation (a)).

mutations.because: Reverting to an identity-keyed Map lets a later same-identity row silently replace an earlier expired one in the expiry check while packaging still writes every selected asset, so the same-identity test must fail (VE3a fix3 mutation (b)).
